mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT i.task_id FROM management_task_item i WHERE (i.target_type = 'COMIC' AND i.target_id = #{comicId}) OR (i.target_type = 'CHAPTER' AND i.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM chapter WHERE comic_id = #{comicId})) OR (i.target_type = 'MEDIA' AND i.target_id IN (SELECT p.id FROM page p JOIN chapter c ON c.id = p.chapter_id WHERE c.comic_id = #{comicId}))
